query:
SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation') as composite_json
FROM claims c
JOIN ai_assessments a ON a.claim_id = c.id
WHERE c.id = 5850001
LIMIT 1;
